title: Option to display time zone as "Time zone city (Time zone code)"
line: The Digital Clock can now show time zones as city and code, like "London (GMT)".
explanation: The Digital Clock's "Display time zone as" setting only offered Code, City or Offset from UTC time, so the panel, tooltip and popup could show either the city or its abbreviation but never both. The change adds a fourth choice, "City and code" (config value FullTextAndCode), used by the panel label, the tooltip and the popup's time zone list; it shows "London (GMT)", and just the name once when city and code are the same (UTC).

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: add option to show time zones as city and code

The time zone could only be shown as a code, a city or a UTC offset, so
one had to pick between a recognizable name and the short code. Add a
"City and code" format that shows both, for example "London (GMT)".

BUG: 432648

media.caption: Display time zone as: only Code, City or Offset from UTC time

Tooltip and panel with City and code: "London (GMT)", "Rome (CET)"
